errors.text_span: 即最简单的诗排在最下方，最难的诗排在最上方
errors.evidence: This statement misinterprets the relationship between the score and difficulty. The chart title identifies these as the '10 poems with the lowest difficulty'. The bars are sorted in descending order of their numerical score from top to bottom. This means the poem at the top has the highest score (11.75) and the one at the bottom has the lowest score (11.33). Assuming the score represents 'difficulty', the poem with the lowest score at the bottom is the easiest, and the one at the top is the 'hardest' among this easy group. The description correctly states 'the easiest poem is at the bottom', but incorrectly states 'the hardest poem is at the top'. In the context of the title 'lowest difficulty poems', the poem at the top is the one with the highest difficulty score among this selection, not the absolute hardest. This phrasing is confusing and potentially misleading.

errors.text_span: 但由于是按从上到下的顺序读取，实际上是按标题的某种顺序排列
errors.evidence: This clause is nonsensical and contradicts the previous correct statement that the chart is sorted by difficulty score. The chart is unambiguously sorted by the numerical values, not by any discernible order of the titles.

The description only provides approximate values for the highest and lowest scoring poems. It fails to mention the exact numerical scores for the other eight poems, which are clearly labeled on the chart. It also omits the notable feature that four poems share the exact same score (11.42285962) and two others also share a score (11.35833271).
